title: Just-Peachy full streaming speech-pipeline public contracts
description: Versioned, model-independent public contracts for streaming audio, ASR, diarization, open-set identity, enrollment, session state, telemetry, and final results. Score fields are raw backend scores with explicit score types and must not be interpreted as calibrated likelihoods.

rawScoreType.description: Semantic name for an uncalibrated backend score, such as cosine_similarity, logit, or log_likelihood. A raw score type cannot claim probability semantics. Calibrated probabilities require a separate future field with calibration method and identity.

portableLogicalPath.description: Forward-slash logical path resolved outside the contract; never an absolute machine path.

raw_score.description: Uncalibrated backend score; interpret only according to score_type.

biometricArtifactReference.description: Protected reference for enrollment audio, speaker embeddings, and enrollment templates. Biometric payload bytes remain outside general event logs.
